title: axiom.json
description: Axiom project configuration: styling variant, aliases and copied items. See https://axiom.dev/configuration.

$schema.description: JSON Schema used by your editor. The CLI ignores it.

styling.description: The styling tool of the project. Decides which variant `add` copies.

icons.description: Where the icons of the project come from. Decides which icon registry `add icon` creates. Asked the first time an item needs icons.

aliases.description: Where each layer is copied and imported from. A missing key uses its default.

components.description: Typography, atoms, molecules, organisms and templates layers.

items.description: Every Axiom item copied into the project, internal dependencies included, sorted alphabetically.

alias.description: An import alias resolved through the `paths` of tsconfig.json.
